justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: 94% improvement rate is promising; comparison to dose-matched conventional therapy is the key test and evidence is emerging.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Specialized intensive program training; limited sites; significant time commitment; international origins.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Very specialized for children with neurological conditions in intensive therapy settings; limited US availability.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Billed as intensive PT/OT; variable US payer coverage; international origins limit domestic payer recognition.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Limited US employer demand; primarily academic pediatric centers.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Children and families report high satisfaction; peer social environment adds value.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Pediatric intensive model is overwhelmingly cash-pay; parents of children with CP/neuro conditions readily pay.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Burst-care model commands premium block pricing (often $3-8K per intensive).
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Distinctive service model that stands out from traditional outpatient peds.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Other trained clinicians can deliver intensives; model scales with staff and facility.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Strong within pediatric neuro parent communities; modest broader awareness.
justifications.business.efficiency: Moderate training cost; profitable model once operational.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Not a recognized credential for academic promotion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Limited peer-reviewed literature specific to IMOT branding.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Relevant to peds neuro instruction as a service-delivery model.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Intensive model has some support (HABIT, CIMT literature) but IMOT-specific evidence is thin.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely if ever named in faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Short course relative to academic return, but academic return is low.
